explanation: Conjecture 1.1 of Berndt–Bhat–Meyer–Xie–Zaharescu (v1 wording): S(k) > 0 for every odd prime k, where S(k) = Σ_h Σ_j (−1)^{j+1+⌊hj/k⌋}. The definition matches the paper. The current arXiv version adds k > 5, but S(3) = 1 and S(5) = 5, so the two are equivalent. I recomputed S(k) for primes below 2000 and found no violations. The statement is faithful and open.
